other_conditions: Institute must have a digital library network with internet bandwidth of 32 Mbps, Wi‑Fi connectivity, and at least one static IP address
Proposed coordinator must be a full‑time regular faculty member with at least 10 years of teaching and research experience and publications
Co‑coordinator must be a faculty member with at least 7 years of teaching and research experience
Institute must have a postgraduate course in Mechanical Engineering to apply for ASME, Civil Engineering for ASCE, Pharmacy for Bentham Science, or any discipline for Web of Science/Scopus
Applications are accepted only in October–November each year
Applications must be submitted by registered post or speed post; email submissions are not accepted
Eligibility category noted in source: government
Eligibility category noted in source: government-aided
benefits_summary: Provides one‑year subscriptions to e‑Resources such as Web of Science, Scopus, ASME, ASCE and Bentham Science for eligible institutions, renewable based on usage.
